title: Better Brand Bout
one_line_rule: Tap the car brand you like better in each matchup.

brief.intent: A rating game where you rate which car brands are better
brief.notes: Use head-to-head real car brand choices and summarize preferences without right answers. Do not add presentation feedback actions.
